activeProfile.name: Ground companion
activeProfile.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small or Medium terrestrial Beast with ordinary biting anatomy; preserve its actual size. Dog/fox-like examples are illustrative, not free supplied animals.
activeProfile.attack: One melee bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d6piercing; no addedWIS damage and no automatic level scaling.
activeProfile.sense: Choose its actually sourced keen hearing OR smell, if present, for advantage on that sense's actual Perception checks. No new keen sense if absent.
activeProfile.limits: No Pack Tactics, knockdown, grapple, multiattack, burrow or extraordinary source powers. Carrying uses this actual body/STR and ordinary Load/pounds limits, real harness/hands. A mount must separately meet real riding eligibility.

activeProfile.name: Flying companion
activeProfile.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Tiny winged Beast that already possesses natural flight and a pecking/biting attack. No Hover.
activeProfile.attack: One melee peck/bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d4piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.
activeProfile.sense: Retain actual sourced keen sight, if present, as advantage on that sense's Perception checks; no automatic darkvision/blindsight.
activeProfile.limits: No free Flyby, invisibility, aerial carrying exception, Hover, multiattack or ability to carry a Medium ally. Ordinary falling, weather, carrying and support apply.

activeProfile.name: Swimming companion
activeProfile.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small Beast with native swimming and biting anatomy. Keep its real breathing requirements; a fish gains no lungs and an air breather gains no gills.
activeProfile.attack: One melee bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d6piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.
activeProfile.sense: Retain one actually sourced keen hearing OR smell, if present, for that sense's Perception advantage only.
activeProfile.limits: The5ft ground movement is crawling/flopping for a body without legs, paying ordinary crawl cost and suffocation/exposure; no new hands, amphibiousness, Water Breathing, multiattack or sonar.

limits: All animal, relationship, custody, work, rest, prior Ranger selection and class-level attainment facts are explicit conditional premises, not authenticated campaign records.

The model executes named feat lifecycle chronology and HP/control conservation. It does not implement the CRPG, combat/commands, mounted action selection, general physiology, a taming system or all character builds.

Work/rest safety, continuity and Watch-budget support are supplied conditional facts; existing EX58 scheduling is preserved, not reimplemented. Debt-only Rest is denied resource recovery; its separate lawful debt-clearing effects remain outside this model.

The Ranger branch independently checks supplied native feature/eligibility/payment/hour evidence. Its actual prior Hero selection, native allowance and paid cost are conditional premises. No Ranger chassis, release authority, payment-stage timing or feature grant is invented.

The mount interface checks unchanged physical/actor budgets and retained source gates. It does not substitute for the previously reviewed EX58 mounted-phase implementation or claim a mounted combat scenario.

Owner/body changes are named conditional factual events, not new retraining, resurrection or damage-resolution rules. No full335 acquisition, original660-case completion, exact feat review, balance, whole-game approval or cosmology review is claimed.
